title: World Bloom — Turning Pain Into Drive — Episode4 Even Alone

meta.Event Outline: The members of Vivid BAD SQUAD check in on the tree growing in the plaza of their SEKAI. Suddenly, each of them is thrown into a dream showing them a different life, in a world where their paths diverged...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (What just happened? Everything went blurry all of a sudden...)

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
“Hey, Akito, you okay?
You're on soon.”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Wait, of course he is...
I'm in the US.)

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: “Whoa, don't go collapsing on stage or anything, okay?”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
“I'm fine.
And this crowd won't know what hit them.”

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
“Seems like it.
He's really young, but he sounds pretty good.”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (No, I can still do better. A lot better...!)

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: “You had them bouncing off the walls, Akito!”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Yeah, the crowd reacted pretty well...
I still remember the crickets I heard when I first came over here.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (In that sense, things have gotten a lot better...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But this still isn't enough to surpass RAD WEEKEND.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I need to learn how to get the crowd going even more and improve my technique...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: “Yeah, I still need to finish my training routine for today.”

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
“You're so diligent.
But why not hang out with some other musicians for a change?”

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: “Sam and the others were just looking for you. They wanted to see if you'd be interested in going to the after-party.”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Actually, I might learn something new by talking to other musicians.)

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: “You put on another great performance today.”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: “I appreciate you saying that, but I still have a lot of work left to do.”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: “I mean, what's the point if I can't get everyone in the place fired up?”

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line:
“Haha. You don't sound satisfied at all.
I like that hungry spirit of yours!”

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line:
“I really admire your work ethic.
I still remember when you could barely get two words out in English...”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: “That doesn't matter now since I'm a way better speaker now...”

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: “Still, Akito, you've grown so much in a lot of different respects.”

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: “I agree. Every time we watch you perform, we're stunned by how much you've grown since the last time.”

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: “So, Akito, how would you feel about teaming up with us?”

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line:
“Whoa, that was fast!
You won't even try it out for a little bit?”

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: “You aren't helping things by being so overbearing.”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: “I've already decided that I'm not going to team up with anyone.”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If they couldn't make it through that, then that means they've reached their ceiling.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If they're not committed like we are, they're never going to surpass RAD WEEKEND. Right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We have to forget about them and keep moving forward, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? What are you talking about?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I can't keep going after this childish dream.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (At first, I thought his dad was behind what he said.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And by the time I calmed down and felt ready to talk to him, he'd left Japan.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (No, what's done is done. There's no use thinking about this any further...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I just have to keep singing. Alone.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Because... I think that's the best way for me to rise to the top.)

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: “Why did you decide to start singing over here, Akito? Are you chasing after a particular artist or something?”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: “There's an event that I want to surpass...”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: “Yes. An event that I'm willing to spend my entire life on trying to surpass.”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: “I'm focused on doing just that right now.”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I thought I heard someone else's voice just now.)
